sourceStack.value: React 18.3 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 + react-router-dom 6.26 + GSAP 3 (package.json ranges ^18.3.1 / ^5.4.0 / ^3.4.10 / ^6.26.2 / ^3.15.0); dev server port 5210; not a git repository

sectionHeights.method: headless Chromium 1440x900, reduced motion, full scroll to settle lazy media, then getBoundingClientRect of each semantic section located by the rules in extraction/section-map.json (article/legal bodies split at their own h2/h3 headings, story bodies at their spacer separators, changelog rows by year). Every one of the 1,897 served routes plus one 404 probe. Re-measured mid-build: T17/T20/T21/T22 with h2+h3 chapter bounds; T18 after the source changed (src/pages/changelog/ChangelogIndex.jsx footer 'plain' -> 'default'). Re-measured 2026-10-29 (fidelity revision 1.1.0) on the vite preview build: /product/ai-agents/, /roles/customer-experience/, /enterprise/, /dovetail-vs-aurelius/, /the-best-never-guess/, /blog/2025-fall-launch/, /customers/, /resources/ and every T27 (customer story) and T36 (legal doc) route; node lists unchanged, heights/tops updated.

responsive.note: representative route per template: document height at 1440/1280/768/390 and computed styles at 1440 (extraction/measure_responsive.mjs)

specParity.note: clone document height vs the ORIGINAL site's height recorded in the project's own specs at 1440 (geometric, not pixel).

cloneQuality.runnable: clean install = `npm ci` then `npm run dev` (vite --port 5210) / `npm run build`; package-lock.json present. node_modules, dist and public/assets (372MB) are never shipped with the design-repo.

pixelParity.harness: extraction/parity.mjs as of 2026-10-29: adds an image/font settle step (pending lazy switched to eager and awaited, document.fonts.ready, cap 10s, both pages; per-route imagesPending) because the live blog post measured 13,031-16,497px across runs while its lazy article images were still loading. Videos stay paused+hidden on both pages (videosMasked); nothing else is masked.
